lines.greeting: Don't lean on the bellows. What do you need?
lines.the_tower: I won't say more than I already have about the tower.
lines.the_dragon: If it's near the tower, it's the reeve's problem. Not mine.
lines.the_drake: Strange little thing at your heel. Keep it out of the forge.
lines.gold_eyed_one: I've said all I'll say about that mark.
lines.trade: Iron sword's thirty coin. Jerkin's twenty-five. Take or leave.
lines.press_too_far: I am at my anvil. You are in my way.
